title: Chief Minister's Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme (CMCHIS) Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Tamil Nadu government health insurance programme providing cashless hospitalization for eligible families through empanelled hospitals and specified treatment packages.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Eligibility is based on current Tamil Nadu residence and the currently notified household/income or beneficiary conditions; exact criteria must be verified against the latest CMCHIS rules.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Chief Minister's Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme (CMCHIS).

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
